title: U.S. Standard Atmosphere pressure vs. height plot (0–100 km), appendix
description: Mathcad worksheet page showing spline interpolation functions for atmospheric pressure, temperature, and density, followed by a graph of p_atm(height) from 1×10^5 Pa at sea level decaying toward zero by about 40 km on a height axis to 1×10^5 m. Text notes "These functions provide atmospheric pressure, temperature, and density for the U.S. Standard Atmosphere from 0 to 100 km in height."
